end.summary:
Ishaan practised finding polygon perimeters by adding all side lengths.
Ishaan used 2 × (length + breadth) for rectangles and 4 × side for squares.
Ishaan solved perimeter problems involving multiple rounds and finding a missing side.
Ishaan explained that perimeter means the complete boundary and that all polygon sides are added.
Teach-back was not completed successfully.
end.parentNote: Ishaan practised perimeter by adding side lengths, using rectangle and square formulas, and working backwards from a given perimeter. Ishaan explained the method by identifying repeated lengths and dividing the remaining total between two breadths. Ishaan first gave the same perimeter for a square and a rectangle, then corrected the rectangle calculation later by using its 20 cm and 10 cm sides. At home, ask Ishaan to find the perimeter of three household objects and say whether adding all sides or using a formula is more convenient.
